svg.title: jetowl_fc — ROS 2 node diagram
svg.text: Inputs on the left, outputs on the right · topics as chips, services in magenta, topics without a publisher dashed red · links of a closed loop in red · wiring from the System Node Graph
micro-ROS (rclc, FreeRTOS) on the STM32N657: XRCE-DDS over
on the Jetson (:8888); topic contract in the firmware's
Firmware on the MCU (OTA from Server_OTA), not a Kubernetes
→ may only distrust a GNSS receiver
Closed loops through this node (System Node Graph, section 2)
(GNSS attack → LAND, command link jammed and lost → RTH) → /jetowl/security/response → uav_state_estimator (stops fusing a
distrusted receiver) → /jetowl/security/advice → jetowl_fc (/gps/fix NO_FIX for that receiver) → next epochs measured again
Status: Closed. The FC only lowers GNSS trust; every flight decision stays on the Jetson (JetOwl_FlightControl
Loop 8c · Remote_UAV RTH button and missions
remote → LoRa → jetowl_fc → /jetowl/status rc_rth_request → jetowl_bridge → flight/nav_command RTH (switch AUTO only);
Status: Closed through loop 4; the pilot's switch decides whether the Jetson flies (JetOwl_FlightControl docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
jetowl_fc → /jetowl/camera/request → snapshot_node → /jetowl/camera/jpeg → jetowl_fc → 2.4 GHz image slot → remote;
/jetowl/camera/fc_status (bitmap of chunks held) → snapshot_node resends the missing ones
Status: Closed by acknowledgement (selective repeat, CRC-32)
Loop 8e · GNSS-free navigation and return to home
Status: Closed. With GNSS distrusted, the camera + LPB40B velocity keeps the ENU estimate (and home) valid; a GNSS attack or
lost fix with healthy navigation → RTH along the flown path, σ_h above its bound → LAND (ros2_gnss_denied_nav README)
Status: Closed. Previously there was no barometer source
